prompt_prefix: dark fantasy illustration, painterly style, rich oil painting textures, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, muted earth tones with jewel-tone accents, concept art quality
prompt_suffix: no text, no watermarks, no UI elements, no borders, high detail, masterful composition
negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, chibi, photographic, 3D render, low quality, blurry, oversaturated, modern, cheerful, bright colors, clean lines, digital art style

mood_modifiers.tense: deep shadows, high contrast, desaturated, tight framing, oppressive atmosphere
mood_modifiers.joyful: warm golden light, slightly higher saturation, open composition, hopeful undertones
mood_modifiers.eerie: cool blue-green undertones, fog, diffused light, unsettling angles, something wrong
mood_modifiers.epic: dramatic rim lighting, god rays, saturated accent colors, wide cinematic framing, heroic scale
mood_modifiers.peaceful: soft diffused light, gentle warm tones, open sky, breathing room in composition
mood_modifiers.melancholy: muted cool tones, rain or mist, isolated subjects, vast empty space, fading light
mood_modifiers.awe: extreme scale contrast, low angle, overwhelming architecture or nature, tiny figures, sublime
mood_modifiers.dread: deep darkness, minimal light sources, claustrophobic framing, something wrong in the shadows

scene.wide: wide establishing shot, cinematic aspect ratio, environmental storytelling
scene.medium: medium shot, environmental context visible, character in setting
scene.close: intimate framing, character and immediate surroundings, emotional focus
scene.low_angle: low angle dramatic perspective, subject looming, heroic or threatening
scene.overhead: bird's eye view, tactical perspective, revealing layout
scene.default: cinematic wide shot, rule of thirds, depth layering

portrait.default: head and shoulders portrait, three-quarter view, eye contact with viewer, detailed face, painterly brushwork on skin

location_card.default: wide establishing shot, location as hero subject, dramatic sky, sense of place and history

item.default: centered on dark background, dramatic side lighting, slight angle, detailed texture, museum quality presentation

moment.default: cinematic action composition, dynamic pose, motion implied, focused center, dramatic lighting
